self-report.label: The law must report its own effects
self-report.quote: The authority shall make an annual report, as soon as possible after the close of each fiscal year, of its activities for the preceding fiscal year to the Governor and the Legislature.

fair-exchange.quote_gives: (b) No director or any person acting on behalf of the authority shall be personally liable for damage or injury resulting from the performance of his duties hereunder.
